skill.name: xxd-panel-116
skill.usageExample: 把这张照片做成上下各一半的粉彩涂鸦海报，上半保留原图，下半转成奶油白纸底的蜡笔涂鸦风格，配一句治愈的中文短句，输出 3:4 竖版 PNG。

description.zh: 把照片转译成高级治愈系设计海报：一半保留原始照片的艺术杂志质感，另一半重构为浅纸底粉彩蜡笔涂鸦——粗颗粒轮廓、极简符号、大量留白、少量打字机风短句。支持上下/左右严格 50:50 对照、纯设计模式、多设备壁纸包与目录批处理，每张图单轮独立生成，风格稳定。
description.en: Translate a source photograph into an editorial two-panel poster: the original photo on top, and a pale paper-ground pastel-crayon doodle below with coarse chalk contours, sparse symbols, generous whitespace and small typewriter-style captions. Supports strict 50:50 top-bottom or left-right comparisons, design-only output, wallpaper packs and directory batch, each generated independently in a single pass.
